title: Couscous Bowl with Irish Sausage and Vegetables
description: A hearty one-pot dish featuring Irish sausage, couscous, and a variety of vegetables, all cooked to perfection.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large bowl over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the Irish sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Stir in the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add the couscous and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low, cover the bowl with a lid, and simmer for 10-12 minutes or until the couscous is tender.
Stir in the peas and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Cook the Irish sausage to an internal temperature of at least 160°F (71°C) for food safety.
Check the internal temperature of the sausage with a food thermometer to ensure it reaches a safe minimum internal temperature.
